    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    colors=set(v for row in out for v in row)
    bg=max(colors,key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in out))

    # line to a non-background boundary cell on the same row or column.
    seeds=[(r,c,out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if out[r][c] not in (bg,4) and 0<r<h-1 and 0<c<w-1]
    for r,c,color in seeds:
        # The boundary segment of a different color identifies which axis/direction
        # the ray travels; rays stop at the seed and do not overwrite the boundary.
        for dr,dc in ((0,-1),(0,1),(-1,0),(1,0)):
